description: Aggregate results of the v1 pipeline (question-only embeddings, top-1 cosine, gate at 0.45 that still called the LLM) on both evaluation sets, recorded before any v2 change. Dev numbers come from eval/results.md at commit 7bc0f64; held-out numbers were measured once with the v1 retriever (commit f3dc94c) right after eval/heldout.json was committed. The fresh set (eval/fresh.json) was measured with the v1 retriever from commit f3dc94c after it was committed.
